ModMetaData.name: DMS 军团钻井驳机性能优化 / DMS Legion Drilling Barge Perf Fix
ModMetaData.author: WhiteGiverMa
ModMetaData.description:
消除 DMSL_Mech_DrillingBarge（钻井驳机）深钻井工作扫描的性能尖峰：原版在默认设置下会把整张地图（325×325 = 105,625 格）当成候选工作格，并逐格做一次 21 格半径的深层资源检查；同时每次检查都会重复查询 DefDatabase 并遍历 comps。本补丁用每张地图一份、随 DeepResourceGrid.SetAt 增量维护的索引替换这两处热点，逐格结果与原版完全一致，不改动任何 DLL/XML。
Removes the drilling barge deep-drill work-scan spikes: with default settings the upstream work giver yields the entire map (105,625 cells on 325x325) and validates every cell with a 21-cell radial deep-resource scan, re-querying DefDatabase and walking comps on each check. This patch replaces both hot paths with a per-map index that is updated incrementally from DeepResourceGrid.SetAt. Cell-for-cell results are identical, and no DLL or XML of the original mod is touched.
纯运行时 Harmony 补丁，不写入存档数据，可随时安全添加或移除。 Pure runtime Harmony patch. Nothing is scribed, so it can be added or removed at any time.
